english.note: Use 毅力 as the all-purpose noun for the ability to keep going despite setbacks.
This is the all-purpose choice for persistence and determination toward a goal.
Use this when emphasizing the inner strength and endurance needed to keep going over time.
Choose this when the emphasis is on persistence and continuing despite difficulty rather than physical stamina alone.
Use this when the pluck means persistence and determination over time.
Use this for the persistence to continue through weakness, frustration, or adversity, where the emphasis is fortitude rather than fearlessness.

examples.english: Despite repeated failures, I still completed the plan through perseverance.
examples.traditional: 面對一次又一次失敗，我仲係靠毅力完成咗個計劃。
